'''Sean Kerr''' is credited on 1 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]] as the originator of the card idea ("Original concept by …").<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited card is in [[Virtual Set 8]], dated 2017 on this wiki. He finished 19th at the [[2008 Yavin 4 Regionals]] with 2 (−100).<ref name="sf-20194-302448">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302448#p302448 The OFFICIAL Yavin IV Regional 2k8 Thread - May 17th], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181028/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20194-start60.html Internet Archive]</ref>
